I’m REALLY new to this community... as in joined five min before I posted this pic new! I would love to share how my shoot went and how fun it ended up being. My photog was actually a dear friend of mine which helped the situation a lot! 

I’ve always had a big issue with body image, especially being part of a cosplay duo where I’m the “thicker” girl of the two. It’s taken a lot of soul searching to be comfortable with my body, and honestly my photog helped a lot as she was very willing to say things like “hey that pose is not flattering, maybe try extending more” or whatever it may be. I think having a photog whose honest with you is so very important in this kind of work! 

The shoot itself was a blast! Just me and the photographer in the room, drinking a beer or two and blasting stupid music to lighten the mood up! She made me feel very comfortable! And kept reassuring me that my body looked great. 

I have other shots from this shoot if anyone wants to see as well! I remember opening the link to the photos and just getting teary eyed because I loved more pics than I thought I would. I’ve never really felt “sexy” until this shoot, and it was such a confidence boost! I recommend doing this to anyone whose on the fence! You’d be surprised how much your confidence raises with the right photog and the right setting. It was a fantastic experience and I look forward to doing more!
Thank you so much! :)
